description: A user account: profile, skin profile, account status and at most two reminders (table APP_USER + REMINDER).

email.description: E-mail address stored in lower case, 3-254 characters, exactly one @.

password_hash.description: Argon2id hash in PHC format, starts with $argon2id$, at most 255 characters.

first_name.description: First name, 1-80 characters, no leading or trailing space.

last_name.description: Last name, 1-80 characters, no leading or trailing space.

date_of_birth.description: Calendar day of birth, a date at 00:00 UTC.

skin_type.description: Skin type: normal, dry, oily, combination or sensitive.

main_concern.description: Main self-reported concern, one of the eight allowed values.

climate.description: Climate: temperate, humid, dry or cold.

time_zone.description: IANA time-zone name, for example Europe/Bucharest, at most 64 characters.

account_status.description: Account state: verification, failed logins, lock and deletion marker.

email_verified_at.description: Moment the e-mail was verified, null or absent until then.

locked_until.description: End of the login lock, null or absent when not locked.

deletion_requested_at.description: Marker of a running account deletion, null or absent otherwise.

reminders.description: At most two reminders, one per period (AM, PM).

items.description: One reminder: period, local time and on/off switch; AM between 04:00 and 11:59, PM between 12:00 and 23:59.

enabled.description: true when the reminder is switched on.
